fee_notes: Standard fee is $65,000 per unit. Area Development Agreement reduces per-unit fee: $65,000 each for 2-unit commitment; $55,000 each for first 5 units and $45,000 each for units 6-10 (3-10 unit commitment). Development Fee range $130,000-$500,000. Opening Marketing Plan Fee $3,000-$6,000 additional.
raw_excerpt: Our standard initial franchise fee for each Franchised Business is $65,000 ("Initial Franchise Fee").
